title: Food Preparation and Dishes
summary: Recipes, dishes, preparation steps, and food comparison.
whyItMatters: Recipe language combines ingredients, quantities, techniques, timing, texture, and safe sequencing.

mentalModel.title: Ingredient, action, result
mentalModel.content: Connect each ingredient to a technique and expected change.

mentalModel.title: Preparation is a timed sequence
mentalModel.content: Organize setup, cooking, checking, and serving.

ruleBlocks.title: Measure ingredients precisely
ruleBlocks.content: Use weight, volume, portions, and approximate quantities appropriately.

ruleBlocks.title: Choose exact preparation verbs
ruleBlocks.content: Use schneiden, rühren, braten, kochen, backen, würzen, and ziehen lassen.

ruleBlocks.title: Signal order and simultaneity
ruleBlocks.content: Use zuerst, anschließend, währenddessen, sobald, and zum Schluss.

examples.de: Zuerst werden die Zwiebeln fein geschnitten.
examples.en: First the onions are finely chopped.

examples.de: Braten Sie das Gemüse, bis es leicht gebräunt ist.
examples.en: Fry the vegetables until lightly browned.

examples.de: Die Soße wird so lange gerührt, bis sie cremig ist.
examples.en: The sauce is stirred until creamy.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use machen for every preparation step.
Give steps without quantities or timing.
commonMistakes.correct: Include enough information to reproduce the dish.

comparisons.summary: Preparation actions naturally produce result clauses.
The communication lesson evaluates taste, texture, and suitability.
